scope: Unchanged Windows SDK bitmap scaling GUI translated into Wasm inside browser with actual Wine base DLLs. Nine stages in EXE/ZIP/catalog modes compare 125440 drawing-area pixels against native Wine snapshots: four scaling modes, mirroring, crops, complex clipping, XOR raster operations, saved DC modes and shrinking. Guest checks raw alpha bytes and object cleanup. Universal Windows/DLL compatibility remains incomplete.
oracleReference: Wine11 desktop x86 macOS; actual StretchDIBits into 32-bit DIB with GetPixel and raw destination alpha readback
testProvenance: Final production build, visible Chromium, static /winebrowser/ deployment-layout acceptance
